articles.summary: Microsoft integrates Anthropic's Claude AI models—Claude Sonnet 4 and Opus 4.1—into Microsoft 365 Copilot, expanding AI model choice for enterprises. This collaboration boosts productivity by enhancing reasoning, workflow automation, and research capabilities, positioning Microsoft as a leader in AI‑driven enterprise solutions.
articles.title: Microsoft and Anthropic Join Forces: Claude AI Models Now Power Microsoft 365 Copilot
